Welcome to our new vlog!
We started our journey from Tashkent International Airport and flew to Manas International Airport in Bishkek with Centrum Air. After landing in Kyrgyzstan, we used a Saily eSIM to stay connected.
For our stay, we checked into OLOLO Yurt Hostel in Bishkek . After settling in, we stepped out to explore the city, tried some local food and enjoyed a cold brew before starting our evening tour of Bishkek.
